card.name: Antibiotic text before bacteria and quinolones
card.fires_on: The 'oro' inside 'fluoroquinolone' and small linking words (against, to, or, non) in antibacterial-spectrum text, right before an organism or infection is named.

modes.label: Inside fluoroquinolone
modes.description: The 'oro' piece in the middle of 'Fluoroquinolones' or 'fluoroquinolone'.

modes.label: Linking word before organism
modes.description: A small word such as 'against', 'to' or 'or' just before a bacterium or infection type.
modes.example: since cefotetan has no activity<< against>> this organism.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like Gram, susceptibility and resistance, and away from 'reactive' and 'adaptive'.
